item.title: Will the USS Connecticut Submarine Finally Return to Duty This Year?
item.description: Following a disastrous underwater collision, the Connecticut was originally scheduled to complete repairs in 2025—but its return was pushed back to this year, and could be further delayed. The post Will the USS Connecticut Submarine Finally Return to Duty This Year? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The US Navy’s SSN(X) Submarine Program Is Slowly Sinking
item.description: The US Navy does not have the capacity to build the SSN(X) submarines at scale—but rather than acknowledging this, it has simply attempted to delay their completion dates. The post The US Navy’s SSN(X) Submarine Program Is Slowly Sinking appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: F-35 or Gripen? Canada’s Fighter Jet Dilemma, Explained
item.description: Canada was long expected to buy the F-35 Lightning II to replace its aging CF-18 fighters—but political tensions with America, and a surprising offer from Sweden, have upended these assumptions. The post F-35 or Gripen? Canada’s Fighter Jet Dilemma, Explained appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The KC-10 Extender: America’s Greatest Tanker Plane Ever?
item.description: In spite of the KC-10’s admirable qualities, and its decades of valuable service, the Pentagon ultimately scrapped the program in 2024. The post The KC-10 Extender: America’s Greatest Tanker Plane Ever? appeared first on The National Interest.
